marcus-webb.name: Marcus Webb
marcus-webb.title: Editor-in-Chief
marcus-webb.bio: Marcus Webb spent a decade writing about men's style and grooming for UK print and digital publications before relocating to the Gulf. The first thing he noticed after moving was that his entire grooming routine stopped working. Products that had been reliable for years started underperforming, and his hair began thinning in ways it never had in London. That experience became the founding idea for Gulf Grooming Report: an honest, tested resource for men dealing with the Gulf's specific climate and water challenges. He runs all editorial operations and personally tests every product featured in the site's major guides.
marcus-webb.credentials: Former contributing editor UK men's lifestyle publishing, 9 years covering men's grooming and personal care, Gulf resident since 2017

tariq-al-rashid.name: Tariq Al-Rashid
tariq-al-rashid.title: Health and Wellness Writer
tariq-al-rashid.bio: Tariq Al-Rashid covers the clinical and scientific side of men's hair and wellness without making it feel like a medical journal. He spent three years researching his own hair loss before finding an approach that worked, and that experience informs how he writes: he assumes his reader is intelligent, skeptical, and tired of vague advice. He covers treatments, ingredients, and procedures, translating the science into practical decisions.
tariq-al-rashid.credentials: Health journalism background, regional fitness and men's health publications, personal history with hair thinning and treatment research

james-croft.name: James Croft
james-croft.title: Grooming Products Reviewer
james-croft.bio: James Croft spent five years working inside consumer goods companies before deciding the most useful thing he could do was test products honestly for people who don't have time to do it themselves. He reviews shampoos, skincare, grooming tools, and personal care products with the systematic approach of someone who once wrote the QA protocols. No affiliate pressure, no brand relationships, just verdicts.
james-croft.credentials: Five years in consumer goods (product development, QA), independent review writer
